This page highlights selected statistical, machine learning, and public health research projects.

:::: {.projects-grid}

::: {.project-card}

### Machine Learning for Breast Cancer Diagnosis

Applied machine learning methods to breast cancer diagnosis data for classification and predictive modeling.

**Methods:** Machine Learning · Classification · Predictive Modeling

:::

::: {.project-card}

## Alzheimer's Disease Progression Modeling

Developed survival and machine-learning models using longitudinal Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) data to study progression from cognitively normal (CN) to mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and dementia.

**Methods:** Cox Regression · Multi-State Survival Analysis · LASSO · DeepSurv · Machine Learning

:::

::: {.project-card}

## Environmental Exposures and Maternal Health

Analyzed associations between environmental metal mixtures and maternal/neonatal health outcomes.

**Methods:** Logistic Regression · WQS Regression · BKMR · Structural Equation Modeling

:::

::: {.project-card}

## HIV and COVID-19 Research

Contributed to epidemiological studies involving HIV/AIDS and COVID-19, including research on excess mortality among people with HIV in Florida during the early COVID-19 period.

**Methods:** Epidemiologic Analysis · Farrington Algorithm · Regression Modeling

:::

::: {.project-card}

## Climate Change and Community Health

Contributed to the **Climate Change and Community Health Consequences in Colombia (5C)** project involving population-based cohort research on climate and health outcomes in South America.

**Area:** Climate Health · Epidemiology · Population Health

:::

::: {.project-card}

## Regression Analysis Using IML

Statistical computing project involving regression analysis using SAS Interactive Matrix Language (IML).

**Methods:** Regression · Matrix Computing · SAS/IML

:::

::: {.project-card}

## Hurricane Harvey: Utility Disruption, Damage, and Household Wellbeing

Analyzed data related to Hurricane Harvey to investigate utility disruption, damage, and household wellbeing.

**Area:** Environmental Health · Disaster Research · Statistical Analysis

:::

::: {.project-card}

## Prediction of Algerian Forest Fires

Developed predictive analyses using data from the Bejaia and Sidi-Bel Abbes regions.

**Area:** Predictive Modeling · Statistical Learning

:::
